task: Add Nov 8 cascade and post-flush retest to Bossman market memory without hindsight leakage or ungrounded trade signal.

provenance.source: User screenshots of K1m6a Coinwise BTCUSD 30m Coinbase chart; time shown New York; full exchange feed and exact video URL not established.
provenance.raw_images: Owner conversation uploads, not committed to repository. Request explicit source media or locally mounted files for deterministic frame hashes.
provenance.warning: Coinwise chart BTCUSD (Coinbase) and left-side footprint/orderflow or right-hand trades may show different instruments/venues. Do not merge those prices, deltas or OI without identity match.

observed_sequence.decision: NO_SETUP: price and CVD capitulation alone are not evidence of a bottom
WAIT for reclaim/hold and retest; beware false breakout
NO_SETUP until price recovers lost structure

key_lessons: Multi-frame temporal evidence is more useful than isolated screenshot guesses.
Price↓ CVD↓ OI↓ plus large long liquidations indicates a deleveraging or cascade candidate, not an automatic bottom.
The first bounce can fail; confirm lost level reclaim, acceptance and retest before PROMOTED long setup.
CVD uptick with price flat is ambiguous; test bid/ask absorption versus buyer inefficiency using price response and depth.
OI alone is not a directional long/short count; new leverage can support either side.
Right-side trade tape and central BTCUSD Coinbase chart must not be treated as identical until symbols, venues and quote units verified.
Do not assert measured forecast probabilities (45/35/20) without calibrated out-of-sample validation.
Do not mark multiple crops of the same timestamp as independent evidence.
A post-flush rebound may fail; capture BOTH long and short outcomes and label NO_SETUP as valid.

training_workflow.candidate_long: Price holds/recovers zone after wick, CVD stabilizes or rises, reclaim above prior loss level and retest acceptance, costs/risk justified
training_workflow.candidate_short: Failed reclaim at lost structure, subsequent price and CVD weakness, OI regime assessed; not blind short after cascade
training_workflow.leakage_guard: For each decision timestamp use only data observable at or before that timestamp. Later screenshots label outcome, not prior features.
verify_before_promotion: exact timestamps and source video IDs
symbol/exchange identity for Price CVD OI
forward MFE/MAE after trigger including slippage/fees
independent verifier and owner or replay outcome

status_note: Not a trading recommendation. No automated order authorization. Outcome not yet verified.
